items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Bud Scott had the best band around up through there, from Natchez, Mississippi.

ctx.x: What kind of bands were up there? Did they sound about the same kind of jazz they played in New Orleans, or?
Well, no, they mostly had string bands all up through there. Bud Scott had the best band around up through there, from Natchez, Mississippi. Then they had a lot of...
Was that the Bud Scott that was with Kidore and went to Chicago?
